text_to_image_prompt: Create one standalone photorealistic female character portrait. Brown hair loosely tied back with fine face-framing strands and sunglasses resting on the head, fair warm skin, hazel eyes, softly arched brows. Brown long-sleeved scoop-neck top over a cream halter underlayer. Frontal torso with a playful wink and closed-mouth smile. Single person on a seamless pure white background, vertical composition with the entire head visible and breathing space above the hair. Bright soft frontal studio daylight, low-contrast natural shadows, natural detailed skin and individual hair strands, restrained makeup, subtle halation, realistic 50mm perspective, coherent cream-white and warm-brown color grading. Upper-body portrait; retain visible clothing texture and natural folds. No text, watermark, logo, collage, border, other people, scenery, plastic skin, illustration or CGI rendering.
reproduction_note: 根据已确认成图重建独立文生图提示词；未进行纯文字重生成相似度验证，严格保持身份时需结合此成图。

original_prompt: Generate a NEW single-person photorealistic character portrait on a COMPLETELY SOLID PURE WHITE (#FFFFFF) BACKGROUND. WHITE BACKGROUND IS MANDATORY, edge-to-edge behind the subject, no dark corners or gradient. This is one standalone portrait, no collage or panels. First input is visual inspiration for hair and outfit only: invent a new fictional face, do not reproduce reference pixels or exact facial identity. Second input sets the approved soft bright photographic lighting and white background only. Use high-key neutral daylight, broad soft frontal illumination, minimal shadows, fine natural skin texture, subtle halation, 50mm perspective. Young appearance consistent with source; no arbitrary ethnicity changes. No illustration, CGI, plastic skin, dark color grading, heavy makeup, text, badges, logos or watermark. Fully clothed mid-torso casting portrait, whole head with white margin. Character direction: Loose low updo with long face-framing strands, sunglasses resting above hairline, soft brown fitted long sleeve top over ivory scoop-neck layer; friendly wink, torso facing camera. Final requirement: flat PURE WHITE background with no text anywhere.
